acceptanceCriteria.text: Code search tool exists (search by symbol name, text pattern)
Symbol lookup tool exists (find definitions, references)
Dependency graph tool exists (file imports, module deps)

snapshot.description: WM has no code intelligence. Knowns provides knowns_code with AST-based search, symbol lookup, dependency graphs. WM needs equivalent tools for code search across the codebase. This is the largest feature gap.
snapshot.title: Implement code intelligence MCP tools
